P.name: Lightslinger
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Lucian's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|3.5}} seconds fires an additional shot {{tip|on-attack}} after {{fd|0.25}} seconds, which deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 to 60|1;7;13}} AD {{as|physical damage}}}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minion|minions}}. He will shoot the same target, else another target within 50 units beyond his {{sti|range|basic attack range}} automatically.
P.description2: The second shot {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Vigilance:}} Whenever '''Lucian''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} or {{tip|shield|shielded}} by an ally, or an enemy champion within 1000 units is {{tip|immobilized}}, his next two shots within 6 seconds are empowered to deal {{as|15|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. He can store up to 4 empowered shots at a time.

Q.name: Piercing Light
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' fires a laser in a line in the direction of the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.

W.name: Ardent Blaze
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' fires a missile in the target direction that explodes in a cross pattern upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second.
W.description2: Enemies hit are marked for 6 seconds.
W.description3: '''Lucian''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant '''Lucian''' ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian|Vigilance}}''.

E.name: Relentless Pursuit
E.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''Relentless Pursuit's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 1 second for each ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian}}'' shot hit, doubled to 2 seconds against enemy {{tip|champions}}.
E.description3: ''Relentless Pursuit {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Lucian's''' basic attack timer. '''Lucian''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash. Relentless Pursuit can be cast during {{ais|W|Lucian}} cast time and during {{ais|R|Lucian}} channel.''

R.name: The Culling
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lucian''' {{tip|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, rapidly firing up to 22 {{as|(+ {{critical damage|0 to 22.222|flat=true|round=floor|critScaling=true}})|crit chance}} shots in the target direction over the duration. Each shot deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, doubled against {{tip|minions}}. ''The Culling'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage Per Shot|{{ap|15 to 45}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}}}}
